cells.gaps: No sector policy succeeding the 2003 policy is on record as adopted or in preparation, and no report against the policy's targets is held. The policy's own text gives it a life of fifteen to twenty years and rolling plans ending 2022 (GHA-007), while a 2025 report still treats it as in force and calls it outdated (GHA-002) and instruments.csv gives it no period end; finance is not stated and nothing is dated in the last twelve months.
cells.note: ICT for Accelerated Development (ICT4AD) Policy: adopted in 2003 with a public text, but its stated period ended in 2022 and no successor sector policy is in preparation, so it is lapsed and places nothing. The national digital strategy held is a noted class and does not count as its successor.
